scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace src-ui
scripts.test: npm test --workspace src-ui && vitest run --project tooling
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage --workspace src-ui -- --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=html && vitest run --project tooling --coverage --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=html
scripts.coverage:json: npm run coverage --workspace src-ui && vitest run --project tooling --coverage
scripts.test:native: npm run coverage:rust-unit && npm run test:rust-integration && npm run test:native-smoke && npm run coverage:native-report
scripts.test:probes: npm run coverage:json && npm run coverage:rust-unit:json && vitest run tests/probes.test.ts
scripts.coverage:rust-unit:json: bwrap --unshare-net --dev-bind / / --proc /proc vitest run tests/native-coverage.test.ts -t '^unit JSON coverage$'
scripts.test:backend-probe: bwrap --unshare-net --dev-bind / / --proc /proc vitest run tests/native-coverage.test.ts -t '^backend probe coverage$'
scripts.test:native-probe:stages: vitest run tests/native-coverage.test.ts -t '^reset native probe$' && npm run test:native-smoke && vitest run tests/native-coverage.test.ts -t '^native JSON report$'
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test:probes && npm run coverage:verify && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
